heading: FAQ’s on Dating App Development Solutions

items.question: How do you keep users safe?
items.answer: Profile verification, reporting, blocking and moderation tools are built in.

items.question: Can I add video calls?
items.answer: Yes. Video and voice calls can be added.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation.

items.question: Can I offer premium plans?
items.answer: Yes. Subscriptions and in-app purchases are supported.

items.question: Can the matching be customised?
items.answer: Yes. Matching rules can be tailored to your audience.

items.question: How much does a dating app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and platforms. Share your requirements for an estimate.
